You are building a Airbnb-style interface.
Use Airbnb · Design Kit Design Kit as the visual source of truth (scraped from zh.airbnb.com/homes).
Style:
Marketplace discovery — photo-first listings, structured search composer, category nav. Clean white cards on #F7F7F7 canvas.
Foundation:
- Surfaces: #FFFFFF (canvas) / #F7F7F7 (page) / #F2F2F2 (muted)
- Text: #222222 / #717171 / #B0B0B0
- Accent Rausch #FF385C + gradient linear-gradient(to right,#E61E4D 0%,#E31C5F 50%,#D70466 100%) for primary CTA only
- Font (product): Inter, Airbnb Cereal, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
- Font (kit doc UI): PingFang SC for Chinese labels
- Max content width: 1280px; spacing base 4px
- Typography samples: 为你而来的家 (48 / 800 / -.02em) / 11 月 5 日 - 10 日 · ¥6,820 共 5 晚
Components (from source kit):
- btn-primary: gradient, h44, r8; btn-pill for search CTA
- composer: pill search bar with 地点/入住/退房/入住人 fields
- chip / chip.active / chip.brand for filters
- nav-cat horizontal category bar (2px bottom active)
- listing card: image 280×280, price, rating
Motion:
- Hover: 150ms, cubic-bezier(0.1,0.9,0.2,1)
- Medium transitions: 200ms (composer/swatch)
- Input focus: 1px #222222 ring (from kit .input:focus)
Avoid:
- Colors outside documented swatches
- Claude/chat UI patterns not present in source kit
- Blue/purple SaaS gradients unrelated to brand
- Invented dark theme values — source only documents Dark Surface #222222

03

04

# Airbnb · Design Kit Design Kit
## Source
从 zh.airbnb.com/homes 真站抓取 · 388 个 CSS Token · 15 个 Inline Icon
Source file: 爱彼迎kit.html
## Design Intent
Marketplace UI from zh.airbnb.com/homes — listing discovery, structured search, category navigation. Photo-first cards on clean neutral canvas.
## Visual Language
- Canvas: #FFFFFF; page wash: #F7F7F7; muted: #F2F2F2
- Text: #222222 / #717171 / #B0B0B0
- Brand Rausch: #FF385C; gradient CTA: linear-gradient(to right,#E61E4D 0%,#E31C5F 50%,#D70466 100%)
- Semantic: success #008A05, warning #E07912, danger #C13515, info #006AFF
- Borders: #DDDDDD / #EBEBEB
## Typography
- Product UI: Inter, Airbnb Cereal, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
- Scale: Display: 48 / 800 / -.02em; H1: 32 / 700 / -.015em; H2: 24 / 700 / -.01em; H3: 18 / 600; Body LG: 16 / 400; Body: 14 / 400; Caption: 12 / 500
- Kit doc UI (this viewer): PingFang SC for Chinese labels only
## Spacing
4px base grid: s-1 4px, s-2 8px, s-3 12px, s-4 16px, s-5 20px, s-6 24px, s-8 32px, s-10 40px, s-12 48px, s-16 64px
## Radius
tiny 4px, small 8px, medium 12px, large 16px, xlarge 20px, xxlarge 24px, xxlarge28 28px, pill full
## Elevation
--el-0: 0 0 0 1px #DDDDDD inset
--el-1: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.16)
--el-2: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)
--el-3: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)
--el-4: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)
--el-5: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 16px 56px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)
--el-primary: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.20)
--el-high: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)
## Motion
- Enter: cubic-bezier(0.1,0.9,0.2,1)
- Exit: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1)
- Linear: cubic-bezier(0,0,1,1)
- Button hover/transform: 150ms
- Composer/swatch: 200ms
## Components (from source kit)
- Buttons: Primary uses linear-gradient(to right,#E61E4D 0%,#E31C5F 50%,#D70466 100%); pill for search/CTA (Primary 用品牌渐变 · Pill 用于搜索/CTA)
- Composer: structured search fields + circular search button
- Chips: filter/category; .active and .brand states documented in kit
- Nav: horizontal category bar with 2px bottom active indicator
- Listing card: 280×280 image, meta row, price, rating
## Guardrails
- Use only tokens documented in source kit — no invented palette
- Primary CTA uses Rausch gradient; do not replace with flat SaaS blue
- Spacing must stay on 4px grid (s-1 4px …)
- Radius from token scale (tiny 4px …)
- Icons: 15 inline symbols via `<use href="#ic-*"/>`
## AI Context
You are building a Airbnb · Design Kit-style interface. Surfaces #F7F7F7/#FFFFFF, accent #FF385C for CTA only. Font: Inter, Airbnb Cereal, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif. Motion enter cubic-bezier(0.1,0.9,0.2,1), hover 150ms. See linked source kit for component markup.

生成防跑偏规则给 Coding Agent 的正负约束
Do
使用 #F7F7F7 / #FFFFFF 作为基础背景（kit Background swatches），保持柔和与可信赖。
优先使用细边框、轻阴影和明确留白建立层次。
复用 kit 内 .btn / .composer / .listing / .chip / .nav-cat 规则。
标题可以更有编辑感，但正文必须保持清晰易读。
新增页面前先读取 DESIGN.md，再决定布局与组件。
Don’t
不要使用默认 Tailwind / shadcn 的蓝紫色 SaaS 风格。
不要加入玻璃拟态、霓虹光、复杂渐变或赛博质感。
不要随意新增字体、圆角、阴影和 container 宽度。
不要把 Rausch #FF385C 作为大面积背景或过度强调色。
不要为了丰富而添加无意义插画、3D 或复杂动效。
